title: UploadStatusResponse
description:
The resume view an interrupted client asks for: exactly which indices are recorded, so the
remaining chunks can be sent without duplication or guessed gaps.

missing_chunks_count.description: How many derived indices remain unrecorded. Required.

received_chunks.description: Every recorded index, sorted ascending. Required; empty only for a fresh open session.

received_chunks_count.description: How many indices are recorded. Required; equals `received_chunks`' length.

session_state.description: The phase of the session. Required.

UploadResumptionToken.title: UploadResumptionToken
UploadResumptionToken.description:
Server-issued handle naming one upload session. Required on every chunk receipt, status
and finalize call after opening.

Opaque by contract: a client compares tokens, stores them and presents them back, and
never parses one. The issuing service mints it unguessable — at least 128 bits of entropy
— because whoever holds the token drives the session; expiry is the server's decision,
carried beside the token as `expires_at`, and an expired token is refused with
`blob_transfer.session_expired`, distinct from `blob_transfer.session_unknown`.

UploadSessionState.description: The phase of the session answering a status or finalize call.

oneOf.description: Finalize verified the streamed digest; the blob is sealed under its reference.
Finalize proved the streamed digest differs from the declaration; the session is dead.
